# Business Search API Prod available now

_Category: Announcements · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**Fareen** (10/26/2022):

On October 24, a Business Search API was released that provides access to business information and filing information for: cooperative associations, benefit companies, sole proprietorships and general partnerships. API Specs can be found [here](https://developer.bcregistry.daxiom.ca/registry-search-api).

Other changes launched with this release include registration and maintenance filings for sole proprietorships and general partnership. More information can be found on this [Business Registry Resources ](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/assets/gov/employment-business-and-economic-development/business-management/permits-licences-and-registration/registries-other-assets/learn_more_about_the_october_24_launch.pdf)document.
